blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Agentic on-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student agent on its own trajectories while a teacher scores every token. A natural explanation of where it goes wrong is compounding error: the student's mistakes carry its trajectories beyond the region where the teacher is reliable, so recent methods keep training inside that region, through episode-length curricula, teacher-guided turns, prefix replay, or teacher intervention where the two disagree. We show this explanation is incomplete. From the states where the student departs most from the teacher, the teacher's own takeovers still finish the task, yet the student trained on its token scores keeps running out of turns. We attribute this to the myopia of next-token scoring. The teacher rates each token without seeing where the episode ends, so its scores let through the safe, delaying moves that outcome-based RL would punish with zero reward, a penalty agentic OPD lacks. We call this difference between what the teacher does and what it scores the rollout-scorer gap. We propose Rollout-to-Scorer Distillation (R2S), which repairs the scorer before distillation by mining high-disagreement states from the untrained student, running teacher takeovers from them, keeping the states where enough takeovers pass a reward-free check such as consensus or an LLM judge, and fine-tuning the teacher to give its takeover-informed scores on every assistant token from the divergence turn onward, without the takeover in context. The repaired teacher is frozen as the sole scorer for standard OPD, requiring no task reward during repair or training. Across three environments, two teachers and four students, R2S outperforms three state-of-the-art agentic-OPD methods in all twelve teacher-student-environment cells, by 12.8 success points on average over the best of them in each cell. Project page: https://tree-shu-zhao.github.io/r2s/.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Agentic on-policy distillation (OPD) trains an agent on its own trajectories. The student acts in a live environment, and a stronger teacher scores every token it produces ( Liao et al., 2026 ) . The teacher never acts in this loop; it only scores, and its next-token distribution on the student’s histories is the whole training signal. This form of dense supervision also underlies the multi-teacher post-training pipelines of MiMo-V2-Flash and Nemotron-Cascade 2 ( Xiao et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 政策上的代理蒸馏(OPD)在自己的轨迹上训练一种代理. 学生们在活的环境下行动,一个更强的老师给它所制作的每个符号打分(廖等,2026年). 老师从不在这个圈子上行动;它只得分,在学生历史上它的下一张牌是整个训练信号。 这种密集的监督形式也是MiMo-V2-Flash和Nemotron-Cascade 2(Xiao等人,2026年;Yang等人,2026年)培训后多教师管道的基础。

blocks.en: A natural explanation of where agentic OPD goes wrong is compounding error. The student’s mistakes carry its trajectories beyond the region where the teacher is reliable, and its scores there are noise. Recent agentic-OPD methods act on this reading and keep training inside the trusted region, by shortening the student’s episodes ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , handing turns to the teacher ( Li et al., 2026a ) , replaying teacher prefixes ( Liao et al., 2026 ) , or intervening where the two disagree ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , and report gains in their own settings.
blocks.zh: 对代理OPD哪里出错的自然解释是使错误复杂化. 学生的失误会超越老师可靠的区域, 近期的代理-OPD方法在这个读法上起作用,并在受信任的区域内保持训练,方法是缩短学生的剧集(王等人,2026年),向老师(李等人,2026年a)交替,重播教师前缀(廖等人,2026年),或在两人意见不一的情况下进行干预(陈等人,2026年),并报告各自环境下的收益.

blocks.en:
We show this explanation is incomplete. We take the states where the untrained student disagrees most with the teacher, late in its episodes, the states that compounding error should place furthest outside the teacher’s region, and let the teacher act from them. Its takeovers still finish the task. In every environment they beat the student’s own outcome from the same states, and they rescue many of the states the student went on to lose.
The student has not drifted beyond what the teacher can handle. Yet the teacher’s plain scores let the student’s delay pass: only with one of its finishing takeovers in context do they mark down the student’s hedging and searching, and the student trained on the plain scores keeps running out of turns. Figure 1 illustrates this.
blocks.zh:
我们显示这个解释是不完整的。 我们把那些未受过训练的学生与老师意见最不一致的州, 它的接管仍然完成这项任务。 在每一个环境中,他们都从同一个州击败了学生自己的结果,他们拯救了许多学生继续失去的州。
学生没有漂移到老师能应付的程度. 然而,老师的平庸分数让学生的延迟得以通过:只有其中一项在背景中完成的接管,他们才能记下学生的套期和搜索,而接受平庸分数培训的学生却一直走投无路。 图1说明了这一点。

(a) The teacher’s scores let delaying thoughts pass and the episode runs out of turns; its own takeover from that state finishes. (b) With the takeover in context, the teacher scores the delay lower; R2S trains a copy to do so without it.

blocks.en: We attribute this to the myopia of next-token scoring. Acting, the teacher writes the whole episode itself: each action is followed by its consequences and by the teacher’s own next action, and the episode runs to an outcome. Scoring, it rates each of the student’s tokens one at a time, on a history it did not write, without seeing where the episode ends. Under that uncertainty another look or another search keeps options open and is reasonable on its own, so the teacher’s scores let it pass. Outcome-based RL punishes such delay with zero reward when the episode runs out, while agentic OPD has no such penalty. We call this difference between what the teacher does and what it scores the rollout–scorer gap . This motivates informing the scores with selected teacher continuations.
blocks.zh: 我们将此归因于下个托肯分数的近视. 老师自己写整个剧集: 每一场行动都随之而来, 校对:Soup 在这种不确定性下,另一种外观或另一种搜索可以保持选择权,并且本身是合理的,因此教师的分数让它通过。 基于结果的RL在剧集耗尽时以零奖励惩罚这种拖延,而代理性的OPD则没有这种惩罚. 我们称这与老师的工作不同, 这促使通过选定的教师续读来告知分数。

blocks.en: Rollout-to-Scorer Distillation (R2S) repairs the scorer before distillation. First, the teacher takes over from the untrained student’s highest-disagreement states. Second, we keep the states where enough takeovers pass a reward-free check, consensus among them or an LLM judge, and pick the shortest passing one as the reference. Third, we fine-tune the teacher to give its takeover-informed scores on every assistant token from the selected divergence turn onward, without the takeover in context. The repaired teacher is frozen for standard OPD. Student training retains the ordinary OPD objective and rollout recipe, and no task reward enters repair or training. We evaluate R2S across three environments, two teachers and four students under a fixed final-checkpoint protocol. R2S outperforms three state-of-the-art agentic-OPD methods in every cell. The gain over the best of them in each cell averages + 17.0 +17.0 points from the 9B teacher and + 8.5 +8.5 from the 30B-A3B teacher.
blocks.zh: 推出至计分器 Distillation(R2S)在蒸馏前修复计分器. 首先,老师从未受过训练的学生的最高分歧州接手. 第二,我们保留足够多的收购通过无报酬检查的州,他们之间或LLM法官之间达成共识,并选择最短的通过作为参考. 第三,我们微调老师,让老师对选定的分歧转动的每一个助理信物都给出其收购知情的分数,而不进行背景上的收购。 被修复的老师被冰冻为标准的OPD. 学生培训保留了普通的OPD目标和推出配方,没有任务奖励进入修理或培训. 我们通过固定的最终检查点协议,在三个环境中评估R2S,两个教师和四个学生. R2S在每一个细胞中都超越了三种最先进的代理-OPD方法. 每个细胞中优异的增益平均为9B级教师+17.0+17.0分,30B-A3B级教师+8.5+8.5分.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are:
(1) The rollout–scorer gap. Section 3 shows that the teacher’s takeovers still finish from the states where the student departs most from it, while its plain scores let the student’s delay pass; only a finishing takeover in context turns them against it.
(2) R2S. Section 4 introduces a reward-free repair that moves the teacher’s rollout competence into the scores OPD consumes, then freezes the teacher for standard OPD.
(3) Evaluation. We evaluate R2S against three state-of-the-art agentic-OPD methods across twelve model–environment cells under a shared protocol, and measure target fidelity, out-of-turn rates and searching turns in a long-horizon analysis.
blocks.zh:
我们的贡献是:
(1) 推出-分数差距。 第3节显示,教师的接管仍然从学生离校最远的州完成,而教师的普通分数却让学生的延迟过去;只有最后的接管才能使他们反感。
(2) R2S. 第4节引入了免奖励的修补,将教师的推广能力转移到OPD消耗的分数中,然后冻结教师用于标准的OPD.
(3) 评价。 根据共同协议,我们用12种模型环境细胞的三种最先进的代理-OPD方法来评估R2S,并用长距离分析来衡量目标忠实性、外转率和搜索转折率。

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
On-policy distillation for agents. ReOPD identifies a prefix trap: histories closer to the student’s distribution can make the teacher’s targets less reliable, motivating a curriculum over replayed teacher prefixes ( Liao et al., 2026 ) .
Our compared methods address related trajectory-level difficulties: TCOD-F2B schedules rollout depth, Guided-OPD allocates teacher-controlled turns, and FutureBridge validates teacher bridges from high-disagreement states ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
These methods retain the original scorer.
R2S repairs its token scores before student training, a change that can be combined with student-side curricula.

blocks.en: 3.2 Where the Student Drifts, the Teacher Still Finishes
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 学生漂流的地方, 老师仍然完成

blocks.en: Where the student trains is not the whole story. Recent methods trace what goes wrong in agentic OPD to long horizons. The student’s early mistakes compound ( Ross et al., 2011 ) and carry it into states beyond the teacher’s reach, where the teacher’s scores can no longer guide it, so the student learns the wrong thing there. TCOD-F2B, Guided-OPD and FutureBridge therefore keep training within that reach, by shortening the student’s episodes, handing turns to the teacher, or intervening where the two disagree.
blocks.zh: 学生的火车不是全部 最近的方法追踪代理OPD中出错的到长视野. 学生早期的错误复合体(Ross et al.,2011年)并传入教师无法触及的州,教师的分数无法再指导它,因此学生在那里学习错误的东西. 因此,TCOD-F2B、Guided-OPD和FutureBridge通过缩短学生的学习时间、向教师交替或干预两者意见不一致的地方,保持培训的可及性。

blocks.en: The explanation assumes that the states the student drifts into lie beyond what the teacher can handle. If so, the teacher acting from them should fail as well. We test this on the states the explanation points to: the turns at which the untrained student’s next-token distribution departs most from the teacher’s. From each state the teacher takes over eight times. As the success columns of Table 1 show, in every environment its takeovers finish more often than the student did from the same states. The student has not drifted beyond what the teacher can handle.

Once one of its finishing takeovers is in context, the teacher’s scores turn against the student’s delay: in the drop columns of Table 1 , its probability of the student’s hedging and searching words falls two to three times as much as that of the rest of the student’s thinking. The plain scores OPD trains on lack this direction: these states are within the teacher’s reach, yet the student learns from the teacher’s next-token scores there, not from its rollouts. As a result, the student trained on these plain scores to its final checkpoint still runs out of turns in a third of its held-out ALFWorld and ScienceWorld episodes and in more than half of its WebShop ones, about twice as often as when it trains on the repaired teacher.

blocks.en: 3.3 The Scorer Never Sees Where the Episode Ends
blocks.zh: 3.3 记分员从未看到本集的结局

blocks.en: Outcome-based RL punishes delay with zero reward when the episode runs out of turns; plain scoring lacks this continuation signal. Acting, the teacher generates a continuation from the student’s state, observes the consequences of its actions, and reaches an outcome. Scoring, it rates the student’s tokens given the observed history, without that continuation in context. Its probabilities may encode expectations about future outcomes, but ordinary OPD supplies no explicit feedback from the realized task outcome. This distinction matters when useful information gathering and costly delay look similar locally. Another look or search keeps options open, but it spends one turn of a fixed budget, which the student trained on plain scores often uses up. Plain next-token scores carry no penalty for delay: each extra look is scored on its own, and on its own it is reasonable. Conditioning the scorer on a selected teacher continuation changes its supervision on the same student text. We call the distinction between the teacher’s demonstrated rollout competence and its token-level supervision the rollout–scorer gap .
blocks.zh: 基于结果的RL在剧集轮廓耗尽时以零奖励惩罚延迟;普通评分缺乏这种延续信号. 老师从学生的状态中继续学习, 校对:Soup 它的概率可能编码对未来结果的预期,但普通OPD没有从已实现的任务结果中提供明确的反馈. 当收集有用的资料和代价高昂的拖延在当地看来相似时,这种区别就很重要。 另一种外观或搜索保持了选项的开放性,但它花费了固定预算的一个转折,接受过普通分数训练的学生经常使用这个转折. 普通的下手分数不计入延迟的罚分:每次额外外观都是自己得分的,而自己则是合理的. 在选定的教师续作上设置计分器,改变其对同一学生文本的监督. 我们把教师展示的推广能力与其象征性的监督之间的区别称为推广-分数差距。

blocks.en: Design implications. We mine the untrained student’s high-disagreement states and use selected teacher takeovers to inform the scores supplied there. Agreement on an observable outcome or an offline filter supplies the selection rule without reading task reward. We train the teacher to reproduce takeover-informed distributions on every assistant token from the divergence turn onward, without the takeover in context. The repaired teacher then becomes the sole scorer for ordinary OPD.
blocks.zh: 设计方面的影响。 并使用选定的教师接管来告知所提供分数。 就可观察到的结果或离线过滤器达成协议,即提供选择规则,而不阅读任务奖励。 我们训练老师 复制收购信息 在每一个助理的信号 由分歧 转向, 而不收购的背景。 被修复的老师随后成为普通OPD的唯一得分者.

blocks.en: 4 Rollout-to-Scorer Distillation
blocks.zh: 4 推出到计分器

blocks.en: R2S targets the rollout–scorer gap of Section 3 . The teacher’s rollouts from the student’s states carry the judgment its scores lack. As illustrated in Figure 2 , we therefore let the teacher take over from those states, read off the scores it gives with its own ending in view, and fine-tune it to give those scores closed-book, with no takeover in context; the refrozen teacher then scores ordinary OPD. The student never sees a takeover.
blocks.zh: R2S的目标是第3节的推出-分数差距。 老师从学生所在的州推出, 因此,如图2所示,我们让教师从这些州接手,用自己的结局来读取所给出的分数,并对其进行微调,以给出这些分数的闭账本,而不在上下文中被接管;重新封顶的教师然后给普通的OPD分数。 学生从来没有看到收购。

5 Experiments

blocks.en: Our experiments ask four questions. RQ1: does repairing the scorer improve OPD across teachers, students and environments? RQ2: can the takeovers be selected without reward? blocks.en: Protocol. Each teacher–student–environment cell is one 150-step training run. Its final checkpoint is evaluated in three sampled decodes, with no checkpoint selection. In every cell, R2S mines up to 2,400 2{,}400 states, takes K = 8 K{=}8 takeovers from each and fine-tunes the teacher for one epoch.

blocks.en: Training and evaluation. Each step trains on 16 episodes, 128 on WebShop, sampled at temperature 0.4 within a 32,768 32{,}768 -token context; the distillation log-ratio of the sampled estimator enters a clipped PPO surrogate as the per-token advantage, with no additional KL or entropy term, and Adam runs at a constant learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} . Reasoning mode is off for acting, scoring and distillation; a turn is capped at 512 tokens in training and 4,096 4{,}096 at evaluation, and student responses are copied byte-identically into the separately served teacher context. Table entries are the mean ± \pm std over the three decodes of the final checkpoint: its in-training evaluation and two re-loads under further decoding seeds. The teacher acting alone is evaluated through the same path, prompts and seeds.

blocks.en: Repair settings. A turn is eligible for mining when its thinking has at least three tokens and ends in a tool call; we keep the eligible turn with the largest Δ t \Delta_{t} in each episode, at most three states per goal, and the N N states with the largest Δ t \Delta_{t} overall. In the privileged pass the selected takeover enters as one reference message before the student’s first turn, listing the teacher’s thinking and action at each of its steps; T ϕ T_{\phi} sees the same stream without that message. The targets q + q^{+} keep the teacher’s sixteen most probable tokens at each position, renormalized, and are computed once from T 0 T_{0} ; T ϕ T_{\phi} is initialized from T 0 T_{0} and fine-tuned full-parameter for one epoch at learning rate 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} , in batches of eight states, with 10% of goals held out. Appendix C lists every remaining setting.

blocks.en:
Baselines. Vanilla OPD minimizes Eq. 1 with the sampled estimator against the original teacher T 0 T_{0} ; R2S runs the same OPD against the repaired teacher T ϕ T_{\phi} , so vanilla OPD is its direct control.
The other three are recent agentic-OPD methods, chosen because, like R2S, they train the student by distillation alone, without a task-reward RL objective such as GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . TCOD-F2B ( Wang et al., 2026 ) trains the student on shortened episodes that lengthen over training, Guided-OPD ( Li et al., 2026a ) hands part of the turns to the teacher, and FutureBridge ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , the closest prior method, trains the student on validated teacher bridges from the states where the two disagree most.
Their code is public, so all three run under the same models, prompts, estimator and protocol as vanilla OPD and R2S.
We leave out methods that combine distillation with reward-based RL, such as SDAR ( Lu et al., 2026 ) : their students also learn from task reward, which would confound the comparison; a repaired teacher could serve as the distillation term of such a hybrid.
blocks.zh:
基线。 Vanilla OPD 将 Eq. 1 最小化,样本的估算器对原老师T 0 T_{0}; R2S 运行相同的 OPD对修复的老师T  T_{\phi},所以Vanilla OPD是其直接控制.
其他三种是近期的代理-OPD方法,之所以选择,是因为和R2S一样,他们单独通过蒸馏来训练学生,没有像GRPO(Shao等人,2024年)这样的任务奖励RL目标. TCOD-F2B(Wang et al., 2026年)对学生进行缩短课时的训练,延长课时的课时,Guided-OPD(Li et al., 2026a)将部分转弯给老师,FutureBridge(Chen et al., 2026年)是前期最接近的方法,从两人意见最不一致的州对学生进行经过验证的教师桥梁训练.
他们的代码是公开的,因此所有三个运行在相同的模型,提示,估计器和协议下作为香草OPD和R2S.
我们不采用将蒸馏与奖励性RL相结合的方法,例如SDAR(Lu et al., 2026):他们的学生也学习任务奖励,这会混淆比较;修补的老师可以作为这种混合体的蒸馏期.

blocks.en: The teacher can be the student’s own base model. Table 3 repeats the Qwen3.5-4B cells with the 4B as its own teacher. In all three environments, the R2S student taught by the repaired 4B passes the vanilla student that the 9B teaches in Table 2 . Since the teacher and the student are the same model, the student–teacher gap that ranks states is zero, so the pipeline draws one turn per episode of the untrained student at random under the same goal cap and budget; the 4B itself runs the takeovers and the selection, so no larger model enters the pipeline. In all three environments this self-taught student also ends above the 9B teacher acting alone in Table 2 . Taught by the unrepaired 4B, the four other students gain about six points on ALFWorld and at most about a point on WebShop and ScienceWorld: a model’s plain scores of its own tokens teach it little. What lifts the student is not a larger model’s knowledge but scores informed by the ending, which its own base model can supply.

blocks.en:
The teacher’s takeovers can still finish from the states where the student departs most from it,
yet its plain scores let the student’s delay pass; only a finishing takeover in context turns them against it.
R2S transfers information from selected teacher continuations into the
scores used by ordinary OPD. Its repair supervises every assistant
position from the divergence turn onward with takeover-informed targets,
then freezes the repaired teacher as the student’s sole scorer. Under a shared protocol,
R2S outperforms three state-of-the-art agentic-OPD methods in all twelve model–environment cells,
and it also leads when the teacher is the student’s own base model.

普通OPD使用的分数. 它的修理管理着每个助手

blocks.en: Student-side curricula. TCOD-F2B ( Wang et al., 2026 ) gradually lengthens the student’s training episodes. Guided-OPD ( Li et al., 2026a ) assigns a decreasing share of turns to the teacher, combining cross-entropy on teacher tokens with distillation on student tokens. ReOPD ( Liao et al., 2026 ) replays pre-collected teacher prefixes. All three leave the external scorer unchanged; a repaired teacher can supply scores under such curricula as well as under ordinary OPD.
blocks.zh: 学生边课程. TCOD-F2B(Wang等人,2026年)逐渐延长学生的训练节目. Guided-OPD(Li et al., 2026a)为教师分配了逐渐减少的转折份额,将教师代币上的交叉转折与学生代币上的蒸馏相结合. ReOPD (Liao et al., 2026) 重播预集教师前缀. 所有这三名教师都保留外部计分员不变;经修复的教师可以根据这些课程以及普通OPD提供分数。

blocks.en: FutureBridge and teacher continuations. FutureBridge ( Chen et al., 2026 ) is our closest experimental comparator. It continues from high-disagreement student states and validates a bridge with short student rollouts; accepted teacher text enters the student’s training buffer, alongside a curriculum over success-selected reference prefixes. Its online acceptance rule reads no task reward, although the reference pool uses success selection. R2S instead uses a selected takeover as privileged context for teacher repair: the teacher learns to reproduce its informed scores without that context and is then frozen, and the student retains ordinary OPD.
blocks.zh: 未来布里奇和教师续作. FutureBridge(Chen等人,2026年)是我们最接近的实验参照物. 校对:Soup 它的在线接受规则没有读取任务奖励,尽管参考集合使用成功选择. R2S转而将选定的收购作为教师修补的特权背景:教师学会在不使用该背景的情况下复制其知情的分数,然后被冻结,学生保留普通的OPD.

blocks.en: Privileged context and consensus. SDFT ( Shenfeld et al., 2026 ) and Self-Distilled Reasoner ( Zhao et al., 2026b ) train an acting model from a demonstration-conditioned self-teacher. OPCD ( Ye et al., 2026 ) also supports an external context-conditioned teacher, but transfers the context into the student directly. CANON ( Gkountouras et al., 2026 ) supplies a label-free reference by selecting the solution with the majority answer. Our consensus selection follows this principle, applied to an external teacher’s continuations from student states; the model being fitted becomes the scorer of a subsequent distillation stage.
blocks.zh: 特权背景和共识。 SDFT(Shenfeld等人,2026年)和自失常理性(Zhao等人,2026年b)从一个具有示范条件的自学教师中培养一个演技模型. OPCD(Ye等人,2026年)也支持一名外部环境条件化的老师,但将背景直接转移到学生身上. CANON(Gkontouras等人,2026年)通过选择多数答案的解决方案,提供了无标签的参考. 我们的协商一致选择遵循这一原则,适用于来自学生国家的外部教师继续学习;正在安装的模型成为随后蒸馏阶段的计分器。

blocks.en: Feedback and reward-based learning. SDPO ( Hübotter et al., 2026 ) turns rich environment feedback into self-distillation targets, and in scalar-feedback settings uses successful attempts as feedback. SDAR ( Lu et al., 2026 ) is a multi-turn hybrid that keeps reward-based RL as its primary objective and adds gated self-distillation. We exclude this additional student reward signal from the experimental comparison; R2S could supply the distillation scorer of such a hybrid.
blocks.zh: 反馈和基于奖励的学习。 SDPO(Hübotter等人,2026年)将丰富的环境反馈转化为自我消化目标,在scalar-feedback设置中,使用成功的尝试作为反馈. SDAR(Lu et al., 2026)是一种多回合混合体,将基于奖励的RL作为其首要目标,并增加了门式的自沉. 我们从实验比较中排除了这种额外的学生奖励信号;R2S可以提供这种混合体的蒸馏计分器.

blocks.en: External teacher calibration. Distillation Traps and Guards ( Zhan et al., 2026 ) also changes the teacher before distillation, by reinforcement fine-tuning with utility and calibration rewards and a KL anchor; R2S instead fits takeover-informed soft targets on student histories through the cross-entropy of Eq. 3 , without task reward.
blocks.zh: 外师校勘. Distillation Traps and Guards(Zhan等人,2026年)在蒸馏前也更换了教师,方法是通过功用和校准奖励加固微调和KL主锚;R2S转而通过Eq. 3的交叉进取来适应学生历史上知情的软目标,没有任务奖励.

blocks.en: A.2 Further Related Work
blocks.zh: A.2 进一步的相关工作

blocks.en: OPD at scale. MiMo-V2-Flash integrates domain-specialized teachers with dense token-level supervision ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) , and Nemotron-Cascade 2 uses multi-domain OPD between Cascade RL stages to recover capabilities from the strongest intermediate domain checkpoints ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . Our question concerns the quality of the next-token supervision a given teacher supplies on multi-turn student histories.
blocks.zh: 业务发展办公室的规模。 MiMo-V2-Flash整合了域域域专业教师,并设有密集的符号级监管(Xiao等人,2026年),Nemotron-Cascade 2使用Cascade RL级之间的多域OPD,从最强的中间域检查站恢复能力(Yang等人,2026年). 我们的问题涉及对多轮学生历史的教学用品进行后续监督的质量。

blocks.en: Other ways to adapt a model. OPD is one of several routes from a pretrained model to a task. Fine-tuning adapts the weights on fixed data, through low-rank adapters, knowledge-anchored low-resource adaptation or prompt-based continual learning ( Zhao et al., 2026a ; Zhao et al., 2025a ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Zou et al., 2025 ) ; RL adapts them on task reward, as in ParallelSearch for search agents ( Zhao et al., 2025b ) ; in-context learning leaves the weights fixed and adapts through examples, including self-mined errors ( Zhao & Yu, 2026 ) ; and task-specific models are built for one domain ( Hao et al., 2025 ) . Agentic OPD differs from all four in its signal: a teacher’s next-token distribution on the student’s own trajectories, scored while the student acts.
blocks.zh: 适应模型的其他方法。 OPD是从预先训练的模型到任务的若干路线之一. 微调通过低级适配器、知识焦虑低资源适应或即时持续学习,调整固定数据上的权重(Zhao等人,2026a); 赵等,2025a;赵等. 2024; Zou et al., 2025); RL在任务奖励上对其进行了调整,如在"并行搜索搜索搜索"中搜索搜索代理(Zhao et al., 2025b);内文学习留下了权重,并通过实例进行调整,包括自觉错误(Zhao & Yu, 2026);任务特定模式为一个域构建(Hao et al., 2025). Agentic OPD在信号中与所有四个不同:教师在学生自身轨迹上的下个接吻分布,在学生行为时得分.

blocks.en: Local supervision and privileged information. Beyond the compatibility and privileged-context findings of Li et al. (2026b) and Kaur et al. (2026) discussed in Section 2 , Multi-Rollout OPD ( Yu et al., 2026 ) enriches the teacher’s context with peer attempts labelled by success or failure. Our references are teacher takeovers from the student’s own state, selected without task reward and internalized into an external scorer, which we assess through target fidelity and the completion behavior of its distilled students.
blocks.zh: 地方监督和保密信息。 超越了Li等人(2026年b)和Kaur等人的兼容性和特权背景的发现. (2026年)在"多旋律OPD"(Yu et al., 2026)第2节中讨论过, 我们的参考文献是老师从学生所在的州接管,在没有任务奖励的情况下被选中,并内部化成一个外部计分员,我们通过目标忠诚和学生的完成行为来评估这一点。

blocks.en: Filters and mining. A turn is eligible when its thinking span has at least three tokens and when it ends in a tool call. Within each episode we keep the eligible turn with the largest Δ t \Delta_{t} (one state per episode), cap three states per goal, and keep the top N = 2,400 N{=}2{,}400 states by Δ t \Delta_{t} . A state is dropped when its prompt cannot be re-tokenized identically, when its privileged stream exceeds 32,768 32{,}768 tokens, or when it has no privileged position.

blocks.en: Selection. We use two reward-free checks. The consensus vote groups a state’s takeovers by how they end and keeps the state when the largest group holds at least m m of them; the LLM judge, Qwen3.5-9B with reasoning mode on, reads each takeover and keeps the state when it approves at least m = 1 m{=}1 . For Table 2 , the vote uses m = 2 m{=}2 on ALFWorld, over the takeovers that end within the turn budget, and m = 1 m{=}1 on ScienceWorld, over those that end with the environment’s completion message; on WebShop the judge checks each purchase against the instruction, for both teachers, and the approved takeovers are grouped by the item bought. The shortest takeover of the largest group is selected. In Table 4 , the consensus row votes with m = 2 m{=}2 everywhere, and on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld the judge row reads the whole episode but never the reward or the completion message, and takes the shortest approved takeover. Only the ground-truth row of Table 4 reads the task reward.

blocks.en: Privileged targets and plain scores. The frozen teacher T 0 T_{0} scores the student’s unmodified token stream through the end of the episode. In the privileged pass the selected takeover is inserted as one extra user message immediately before the student’s first turn. The message is headed “Reference walkthrough” and lists the teacher’s thinking and action for each takeover step, without the replayed prefix and without environment observations; the header presents it as a successful expert completion of the same task. Every position of the student stream shifts by one constant offset, so the two passes align position by position. The plain pass scores the same stream without the message. Both passes cache per-position top-16 (token, log-probability) lists. Every assistant position from the mined turn, inclusive, to the student’s final assistant turn receives q + q^{+} , including assistant turns without a tool call; earlier history remains causal context, and prompts and environment observations are not targets. R2S trains only on the privileged targets; the plain pass is the reference of the drop columns of Table 1 .

For Qwen3.5-9B the vision tower stays frozen, so full-parameter means the text decoder. The label-SFT control of Table 5 uses the same recipe. The repaired teacher is then refrozen and scores otherwise ordinary OPD in place of T 0 T_{0} , with the sampled estimator of Eq. 4 ; the original teacher takes no part in the student’s training.

blocks.en: Environments. WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) reports success on the 500 canonical evaluation goals and on a disjoint 256-goal pool. blocks.en: Three training runs per method. Figure 3 follows vanilla OPD, TCOD-F2B, Guided-OPD, FutureBridge and R2S from the Qwen3.5-9B teacher to the Qwen3.5-4B student under the protocol of Appendix D . Each method has three training runs per environment, started from the same untrained student and differing only in the training seed; the three R2S runs share the one repaired teacher of Table 2 , so its band reflects student training alone. Each run is evaluated every 25 updates under its own seed, update 0 being the untrained student common to all five curves. Lines are means over the three runs and bands one sample standard deviation, without interpolation or checkpoint selection; the dashed line is the teacher acting alone.
blocks.zh: 每个方法进行三次培训。 图3沿用了香草OPD,TCOD-F2B,Guided-OPD,FutureBridge和R2S从Quen3.5-9B教师到附录D协议下的Quen3.5-4B学生. 每种方法每个环境有三次训练,从同一个未受过训练的学生开始,只在训练种子上有所不同;三种R2S训练共用表2中修理过的一位教师,因此其乐队只反映学生训练. 每一次跑步都会在自己的种子下每25次更新一次评价,更新0是所有5个曲线中常见的未受过训练的学生. 线条是指跨越三跑和带段一样标准偏差,不插图或检查点选择;虚线是老师单独行动的.
